sentence: Shows each car with its driver and seats so group members can claim an open seat, take an empty driver spot, or leave, and see who still has no ride.
use_when: A group needs to sort out who drives and who rides in which car for a trip or event
Members want to pick their own seat in a car
Someone asks who still needs a ride
Planning carpools with a set number of cars and seats
dont_use_when: Splitting gas or trip costs between people
Choosing a time or place for the event
Tracking live location or directions while driving
